name: March of War
Description: A thunderous anthem sung by armies as they advance into battle. The rhythmic drums and horns fill warriors with unstoppable courage.

name: Dragon Slayer's Hymn
Description: Ancient verses passed down through generations of dragon hunters. Each line is a reminder of the beasts that have fallen and those yet to be slain.

name: Bloodmoon Requiem
Description: A haunting war chant performed under the crimson glow of a blood moon. Those who hear it feel the pull of violence in their veins.

name: Thundering Charge
Description: The pounding rhythm of hooves and drums that signals a devastating cavalry charge. Enemies flee before the sound reaches them.

name: Fortress Stand
Description: Sung by defenders who refuse to yield. The song speaks of walls that have never fallen and guards who never sleep.

name: Shadow Strike
Description: A whispered melody that sharpens the senses and quickens the blade. Only the truly skilled dare to sing it before a kill.

name: Iron Will Anthem
Description: A powerful anthem of unbreakable determination. Warriors sing it to steel their minds against fear and pain.

name: Berserker's Fury
Description: A savage war cry that sends warriors into an unstoppable rage. The user becomes a whirlwind of destruction but loses all sense of self-preservation.

name: Tale of Love Lost
Description: A bittersweet song about two lovers separated by war. Its emotional power moves even the coldest hearts to sympathy.

name: The Lost Kingdom
Description: A sweeping epic that chronicles the rise and fall of a forgotten empire. Listeners feel the weight of centuries pass through them.

name: Starlight Serenade
Description: A celestial melody sung only on nights when the stars burn bright. It weaves protective magic into the listener's soul.

name: The Wanderer's Road
Description: A song about the endless journey and the places yet to be seen. It guides travelers safely through dangerous territories.

name: Crimson Rose
Description: A seductive ballad about a mysterious beauty who captivates all who behold her. Perfect for winning the favor of nobility.

name: The Ghost Ship
Description: A chilling sea shanty about a phantom vessel that sails through storms of souls. Those who sing it can sense the presence of the undead.

name: Ember's Lament
Effect: +10 Fire Magic Power, +5% Spell Casting Speed
Description: A mournful song about a phoenix's final death. The flames it conjures burn with the fury of a dying star.

name: The Shepherd's Return
Description: A gentle tale of a shepherd who returns home after a great adventure. Animals gather to listen and obey the singer's call.

name: Prayer of Light
Description: A divine invocation that channels pure radiant energy. Those who hear it feel their ailments fading and their spirits lifting.

name: Song of Healing
Description: A soothing melody that accelerates the body's natural recovery. Even mortal wounds begin to close under its influence.

name: Echoes of the Divine
Description: A celestial chorus that reverberates with the power of the gods themselves. Undead creatures wither at its sound.

name: Darkness Ward
Description: A protective chant that weaves a barrier of light against the encroaching dark. The faithful become beacons in the night.

name: The Eternal Flame
Description: A burning hymn that calls upon the primordial fire. The singer's body glows with inner warmth, immune to cold and flame alike.

name: Whisper of the Stars
Description: A cosmic prayer that draws power from distant stars. Arcane spells cast during this hymn last twice as long.

name: Blessing of the Earth
Description: A deep resonant chant that connects the singer to the living earth. The body becomes as hard as stone, unyielding to blow.

name: Redemption's Call
Description: A brief but powerful prayer that washes away all negative effects. The singer emerges renewed, their sins forgiven.

name: Miner's Song
Description: A rhythmic work song that makes the pickaxe swing true. Miners sing it to find veins of gold and precious gems.

name: Fisherman's Tale
Description: A lazy sea song about the one that got away. Fish gather to hear the story, making the nets full and the catch abundant.

name: Harvest Moon Dance
Description: A lively tune that celebrates the bounty of the earth. Crops grow faster and stronger in its presence.

name: The Blacksmith's Hammer
Description: A rhythmic beat that guides the hammer's fall. Weapons crafted during this song gain exceptional balance and edge.

name: Wandering Merchant's Song
Description: A catchy tune that makes buyers reach for their purses. Merchants sing it to attract customers and seal profitable deals.

name: The Thieves' Anthem
Description: A whispered tune about the art of taking without being seen. Fingers become nimble and eyes sharp in its shadow.

name: Lullaby of the Weary
Description: A gentle melody sung to tired travelers. Those who fall asleep to it wake fully rested and ready for new adventures.

name: The Wanderer's Campfire Song
Description: A warm song about friends gathered around the fire. It keeps the flames alive and the cold at bay through the longest nights.

name: Tinker's Tune
Description: A playful melody that makes machines hum and gadgets gleam. Broken items mend themselves and hidden mechanisms reveal their secrets.

name: Dragonfire Waltz
Description: A sweeping dance that mimics the flight of dragons. The dancer's movements become fluid and powerful, leaving trails of harmless flame.

name: Shadow Step
Description: A silent dance that weaves the dancer into the shadows. Those who perform it become nearly invisible, moving between light and dark.

name: Festival Reel
Description: A fast-paced dance that lifts the spirits of all who join. The music fills the heart with uncontainable happiness.

name: Serpent's Coil
Description: A sinuous dance that mimics the movements of a cobra. The dancer gains serpentine agility and becomes immune to venoms.

name: Anthem of the Free
Description: A powerful call to arms for those who fight for liberty. The song fills the heart with courage and the body with strength.

name: The King's Decree
Description: A majestic proclamation set to music. Those who hear it feel compelled to obey the singer's commands.

name: The People's Voice
Description: A rousing anthem that unites the masses. The singer can command the attention of thousands and sway their opinions.

name: The Eternal Oath
Description: A solemn promise set to eternal melody. Those who hear it swear unbreakable loyalty to the singer and their cause.

name: Nightingale's Gift
Description: A mystical tune sung by the last nightingale. Those who hear it gain a deeper understanding of the world and its mysteries.

name: The Final Curtain
Description: A heartbreaking song of the final moments before defeat. The singer fights with the fury of a cornered beast, knowing death is inevitable.
